claims.text: The patch caused a drop of 11.53 points in positive share at horizon 7 days. Reviews came in a burst during this window; on such windows the method raised false alarms at most 10% of the time in its benchmark. The game's discounts weren't tracked at the time, so a price change can't be ruled out.
Monetization negative sentiment mentions increased by 9.89 percentage points during the window compared to baseline.
Platform policy negative mentions rose by 4.0 percentage points in the window.
Reviewers expressed strong disappointment over permanent price cuts and new editions offering more content for less money after they bought at launch.

findings.title: Price and Edition Changes Frustrate Early Supporters

report.summary: The patch caused a drop of 11.53 points in positive share at horizon 7 days. Monetization negative sentiment mentions increased by 9.89 percentage points, and platform policy negative mentions rose by 4.0 percentage points. Reviewers expressed disappointment over permanent price cuts and new editions. The patch is supported. A price change or sale, off-topic reviews or a review bomb, and a change in who reviewed are inconclusive. Noise or seasonality is rejected.
